steps.command:
set -eu
ensure_group() {
  name="$1"
  gid="$2"
  if ! getent group "$name" >/dev/null; then
    sudo -n groupadd --gid "$gid" "$name"
  fi
  test "$(getent group "$name" | cut -d: -f3)" = "$gid"
}
ensure_user() {
  name="$1"
  uid="$2"
  gid="$3"
  comment="$4"
  if ! id "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    sudo -n useradd --create-home --uid "$uid" --gid "$gid" --groups legacy-users --shell /bin/bash --comment "$comment" "$name"
  fi
  test "$(id -u "$name")" = "$uid"
  test "$(id -g "$name")" = "$gid"
}

ensure_group legacy-users 21000
ensure_group mira 21001
ensure_group niko 21002
ensure_group sana 21003
ensure_user mira 21001 21001 'Mira Patel'
ensure_user niko 21002 21002 'Niko Alvarez'
